reviewed_by: Claude (recovery-control-path); selection reviewed against the diff by the implementing agent, root cause independently validated by a separate subagent
reason: Recovery waited for reconciliation while the execution worker started its command consumers only after restoration and activation, so operator pause/stop stayed queued; goal pause was also classified as work by path. The change attaches the recovery target while blockers remain, holds it in a 'recovering' state that constructs no application, and runs only recovery-safe controls (goal pause, chat turn stop) through a fenced store-only runner (runtime_recovery_controls.py, RuntimeCoordination.queued_controls/claim_control, DurableHttpRunner.run_recovery_control). Goal pause is classified as control from its body (runtime_routes.py, api_worker); start/resume stay work. Claims and uncertain commands are retained; shutdown reports retained claims; restart recovery honours durable operator pause/stop marks (recovery_markers.py, chat.py, chat_goals.py). Python: the new regression file (classification; pause/stop while blocked with work and other controls held; stale owner; duplicate and interrupted claim; activation only after blockers resolve; restart recovery keeps operator pause/stop), the recovery reconciliation and runtime recovery suites (held-phase behaviour changed), runtime delivery (runner refactor and lane classification), the execution worker suite (lifetime changes) and chat goals (write() changes).
exclusions: tests/v3/test_recovery_reconciliation.py::test_retained_prepared_worker_survives_host_detach_and_new_host_activates_saved_recovery fails locally on origin/main as well (no pidfd in the local Python); CI's 3.12 runner is expected to support it. tests/v3/test_harness_chat_goals.py::test_goal_resume_uses_saved_next_harness_in_same_chat fails identically on origin/main and is not selected. test_supervisor.py and test_shutdown_readmission.py need a LAN address/pidfd locally and fail identically on main; the supervisor and shutdown changes are covered by the selected recovery tests. PostgreSQL variants skip without NEBULA_TEST_POSTGRES_URL. No UI, settings or native changes, so frontend, Playwright and native are empty; no settings catalog or product knowledge change.
